services.name: Boat Tour
services.desc: Cruise down the Chicago River with Chicago Line Cruises and listen to our expert guides discuss the architecture, history, and legacy of the skyscrapers overhead. Whether this is your first trip to Chicago, or you’ve lived here your whole life - this boat tour is a phenomenal way to see the city from its most memorable vantage point. blurb: Guests can enjoy architectural and historical tours, private boat charters, and special themed cruises such as jazz and whiskey tasting. The fleet includes three vessels with varying capacities and amenities like bars and stereo systems. Private charters can be customized with catering and beverage packages.
extraNote: If a cruise is canceled, guests are contacted to reschedule · Refunds require calling 312-527-2002 · Boats docked on the slip of water off the Chicago River called Odgen Slip
